veranderings.rede: 'Party' fits countable plurals; with the mass noun 'goud' a partitive 'n deel' is the natural Afrikaans and keeps the same limited quantity.

veranderings.voor: 'n Juwelier koop van die suiwer goud en
veranderings.rede: 'koop van die suiwer goud' can be read as buying from the gold rather than buying some of it; the plain object is clearer and means the same.

veranderings.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
veranderings.voor: kan die mynmaatskappye groot winste maak
veranderings.rede: No mining companies were introduced before, so the definite article points to nothing; the general statement reads naturally without it.

veranderings.voor: 'n Plek waar mense klip waarin goud sit, uit die grond haal.
veranderings.na: 'n Plek waar mense klip met goud daarin uit die grond haal.
veranderings.rede: The relative clause nested inside another clause with a comma before the verb is heavy for Grade 6; the phrase 'met goud daarin' says the same more simply.

vlae.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf; doré-staaf; suiweringswerk
vlae.rede: Attributive 'ru' before a noun is usually inflected ('ruwe goud', as in 'ruwe olie'), but the form appears three times, twice in glossary definitions that may be shared, so it should be changed consistently or not at all; left for the reviewer or writer.
